foldRule: No fold restriction; preserve v563 fold fields only for diagnostics
fitPopulation: For every output object, use all other objects from the same song with clear/approximate labels and a finite original full absolute error; always exclude the current segmentId
estimator: Unweighted median of original signed absolute full errors (fullCandidateAbsoluteMs - actualOnsetMs), statistics.median convention equivalent to numpy median
application: e6CandidateAbsoluteMs = fullCandidateAbsoluteMs - leaveOneOutCorrectionMs; e6ErrorMs = fullErrorMs - leaveOneOutCorrectionMs
candidateSelection: Frozen v558 full candidate as carried by v563; no re-picking, no new candidates, no audio or model inference
primaryMetric: Population-weighted clear+approximate +/-5 ms correct rate using absolute candidate time, with missing candidates incorrect
guardrailMetric: Candidate coverage and noClearCandidateOutputRate must remain identical across all methods

hypotheses.H1: E6 improves population-weighted audible +/-5 ms correct rate over E5
hypotheses.H2: Relative to E5, E6 fixes more population-weighted errors than it breaks and sample-044 remains at least 80%
hypotheses.H3: No object uses its own label in its correction and every result can be independently reconstructed from v563

testPolicy: Exactly one leave-one-out song-level unweighted-median rule; no fold restriction, redline fitting, clipping, weighting, shrinkage, time regression or threshold search
confirmationSetPolicy: Do not read confirmation audio, candidates or labels; development leave-one-out results are not independent confirmation
